body:
Full audit of this package against ground truth — ReadyTrader-Crypto `main` (server launched over MCP stdio, 29 tools listed and exercised) and hermes-agent source (`tools/mcp_tool.py`, `tools/skills_hub.py`, `tools/skill_manager_tool.py`, `tests/skills/test_authoring_standards.py`) — followed by repairs, a mutation-tested validator, and an independent adversarial re-review whose 14 findings are all folded in.

**Recommend squash-merge** (the branch carries 4 relocation commits because the GitHub connector cannot move files).

## What was wrong (severity-ranked)

| # | Sev | Finding | Evidence |
|---|-----|---------|----------|
| 1 | Critical | `get_health`, `get_metrics_snapshot`, `list_pending_executions`, `confirm_execution` do not exist as MCP tools; step 1 of the old workflow could never run | `server.py` + `app/tools/*.py` register 29 tools; health/metrics/approvals are HTTP-only in `api_server.py` |
| 2 | Critical | Tool names documented as `mcp_readytrader-crypto_*`; Hermes registers `mcp__readytrader_crypto__<tool>` | `tools/mcp_tool.py` `sanitize_mcp_name_component` + `mcp_prefixed_tool_name` (called directly to confirm) |
| 3 | Critical | Install instructions targeted a Hermes checkout's `optional-skills/`, which is the Nous contribution tree and is never loaded; SKILL.md at repo root is also not installable by the hub (`owner/repo/<subdir>` required) | `tools/skill_manager_tool.py::_skills_dir`, `optional-skills/DESCRIPTION.md`, `GitHubSource.fetch` |
| 4 | Critical | Example config `command: python` / `args: [app/main.py]` launched a process that died with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'server'` | reproduced; fixed upstream in ReadyTrader-Crypto #5 |
| 5 | Critical (upstream) | Paper `place_cex_order` crashed on every call (`execute_trade() got an unexpected keyword argument 'agent_id'`); upstream tests mocked the engine | reproduced over stdio; fixed in ReadyTrader-Crypto #5 with unmocked tests |
| 6 | High | `description` 67 chars > Hermes hardline 60 — failed Hermes' own `test_authoring_standards` | test run before/after |
| 7 | High | `references/tool-map.md` never referenced from SKILL.md → hub installs silently dropped it; SKILL.md pointed at `docs/`, absent post-install | `_referenced_support_paths` run on old vs new SKILL.md |
| 8 | High | `approve_each` described as returning proposals; in paper mode it never does, and upstream the live path compared an Enum to a string (dead code) | `execution.py::_maybe_propose`; fixed upstream in #5 |
| 9 | High | `get_crypto_price` returns a sentence, not a number; procedure now takes `close` from `fetch_ohlcv` | `market_data.py` |
| 10 | Medium | Private-WS tools bypass the halt flag; `ALLOW_*` allowlists are live-path only; `get_cex_balance` needs real keys even in paper; paper fill uses placeholder `100000.0` when price ≤ 0 | documented; filed as ReadyTrader-Crypto #6 |
| 11 | Medium | AGENTS.md "Verification" listed checks nothing ran; no CI, CHANGELOG, .gitignore | added |
| 12 | Low | `READYTRADER_ROOT` mentioned but the knob is `cwd`; `DEV_MODE=true` not needed for stdio; DOX index listed a folder with no AGENTS.md | fixed |

## What changed
- Skill moved to `skills/finance/readytrader-crypto/` (Hermes `<category>/<name>` layout). All three install paths (hub GitHub-source, hub raw-URL, manual copy) now work; the bundle stays free of repo files.
- `SKILL.md` rewritten to Hermes authoring structure; passes Hermes' `tests/skills/test_authoring_standards.py` (6/6) when vendored into the fork.
- `references/` rewritten from the verified 29-tool roster with per-tool paper-safety classes and the HTTP-only substitutes.
- `docs/HERMES_INTEGRATION.md` rewritten and mirrored to ReadyTrader-Crypto in #5.
- `scripts/validate.py`: frontmatter, hub reference-fetch simulation, config parity, snake_case identifier audit across every markdown file (phantoms only allowed in negated sentences), env-var cross-check, links, hygiene, DOX links, and `--live` (launches `server.py` over MCP stdio, asserts the roster, runs deposit → risk → paper order). Online mode fails closed. Mutation-tested; `--live` is green on the #5 branch and red on `main` with the exact upstream error.
- `CHANGELOG.md` 1.1.0, `.gitignore`, DOX docs for `skills/`, `docs/`, `scripts/`.

## One manual step
`.github/workflows/validate.yml` could not be pushed through the GitHub connector (workflow files require a `workflows` permission it lacks). Add it from the file attached in the session, or run `python3 scripts/validate.py` locally — the file contents are in the session report. It runs the static checks on every push and a weekly `live-smoke` job against ReadyTrader-Crypto `main` (red until #5 merges, which is the honest signal).

## Upstream
- ReadyTrader-Crypto #5 — code + docs fixes (merge first; the skill's Procedure step 5 depends on it)
- ReadyTrader-Crypto #6 — remaining live-safety gaps
